description: Four stacked-bar charts (Q1–Q4, N = 75 each) show how 37 LLMs and interfaces score on questions of increasing difficulty, split into Correct, 2OP, EOP, NOP, Error and Incorrect percentages.
uncertain: All four charts are recorded in full (37 bars × 6 segments each). The image is low resolution, so the numbers have limited precision.

Correct values come from the printed labels or from bar heights. Many labels overlap or are garbled, and a few were read from bar height instead (for example Gemini Web in Q2, and some Llama bars in Q1 and Q3). Treat these as ±1–2 points.
The 2OP, EOP, NOP and Error segments are my estimates from bar geometry, to about ±1.3 points (1/75). They carry no printed labels. Incorrect is the remainder to 100, so it inherits these errors.

Some printed labels disagree with the bar height or with the 1/75 step. I recorded the value that matches the bar. One label differs from its value: Q4 OpenBioLLM-8b-Q8 Local is labelled 36.7% but the bar reads 38.7.
In the Q3 and Q4 charts, the x tick labels in the supplied OCR text are garbled. I took the model names from the Q1 and Q2 axes, and the bar order is identical in all four charts.
